title: SiteWindow: site-energy landscapes and deliverable-capacity limits for hydrogen storage in defect-engineered sp2 carbon
description: SiteWindow constructs, calibrates and evaluates the landscape of hydrogen binding sites in defective, curved and oxygen-functionalized sp2 carbon against the thermodynamic, kinetic and stoichiometric constraints of a storage cycle. It implements a window theory of deliverable capacity for heterogeneous adsorbents with a variational bound, multi-fidelity atomistic workflows for site energies and barriers, electron knock-on and defect-population models with Raman observables, forward thermal-desorption models, and inference of adsorption-energy distributions from the public NIST/ARPA-E isotherm corpus.
